sobreMiDesc1: I am a frontend developer with experience in React, PHP, WordPress, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SCSS. I specialize in creating functional, accessible, and visually appealing web interfaces, applying best practices and paying attention to every development detail.
sobreMiDesc2: I’m driven by continuous learning and always seek to grow, take on new challenges, and improve my skills. In every project, I give my best, aiming to grow professionally and deliver quality solutions.
experienciaDesc: +3 years in frontend development and 1 in backend
descripcionTrabajo1Desc: For three years I was part of this company, where I started as an intern and, thanks to my performance, was incorporated into the team. During this time, I developed new websites for clients, handled modifications to existing sites through a ticketing system, contributed to improving the internal PHP framework, and made targeted adjustments to the official website developed in WordPress.
descripcionTrabajo2Desc: For a year and a half, I worked at this company, where I actively participated in migrating old websites developed with HTML, CSS, and PHP to a WordPress multisite environment, aiming to centralize management and modernize their appearance. I also developed new websites in WordPress and, when needed, implemented custom plugins to meet the specific requirements of each project.
